title: Wed 18 Nov · evening check
summary:

No verified Senate PLFSS result, Fed or MoF remark; Brent ~$92; gold below $3,800 (price only). Dollar shadow +6 holds; franc's VIX trigger carried.
[b]Next:[/b] FOMC minutes 21:00 · AU jobs 02:30 Thu · US claims/Philly Fed 15:30 Thu · Japan CPI 01:30 Fri · UK retail sales 09:00 Fri · Lagarde 10:30 Fri · Canada retail sales 15:30 Fri (Bucharest).

AUD.note: No new item after the Q3 wage beat (raw 3.6, held +3); October jobs Thu 02:30 Bucharest.

NZD.note: No NZ data, RBNZ or election item today.

XAU.note: G −3 unchanged; XAU shadow = G + USD shadow = +3. Gold below $3,800 is price context only.
